summary: Revised comprehensive implementation plan incorporating sequential B1-B2-C1 lecture ordering (01-12), unified Home filters and clean course cards, compact 10-per-batch mobile vocabulary cards with self-test masking, two-person dialogue voices with interactive Role-Play mode, dedicated Progress page with Skill Breakdown Charts and printable CEFR Track Certificates, dedicated Settings page with Voice Accent selector and JSON backup/restore, and an About page featuring the 4-Pillar Bridge Methodology and an interactive A-to-Z Silent-Letter Phonics Matrix.
